scripts.build: tsc -b && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run beam && vite build
scripts.test:plan: esbuild scripts/plan-test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.plan-test.mjs '--external:*.pdf?inline' --log-level=error && node .plan-test.mjs; s=$?; rm -f .plan-test.mjs; exit $s
scripts.test:agent: esbuild scripts/agent-test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.agent-test.mjs '--external:*.pdf?inline' --external:thinking-orbs --log-level=error && node .agent-test.mjs; s=$?; rm -f .agent-test.mjs; exit $s
scripts.test:smart: esbuild scripts/smart-test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.smart-test.mjs '--external:*.pdf?inline' --external:thinking-orbs --log-level=error && node .smart-test.mjs; s=$?; rm -f .smart-test.mjs; exit $s
scripts.test:flow: esbuild scripts/agent-flow-test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.agent-flow-test.mjs '--external:*.pdf?inline' --packages=external --jsx=automatic --log-level=error && node .agent-flow-test.mjs; s=$?; rm -f .agent-flow-test.mjs; exit $s
scripts.test:channels: esbuild scripts/channels-test.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.channels-test.mjs --log-level=error && node .channels-test.mjs; s=$?; rm -f .channels-test.mjs; exit $s
